summary: When queueShapefileSetTx finds a set whole, a key-profile reading (intake-evidence) of any part other than the
.shp that is still queued ends stale with the error 'Read with <stem>.shp as one shapefile.', the words the
part rests with, in the publishing transaction; its source is left unread under the profile. A reading
already running or finished is left. The evidence worker, after claiming a reading, checks under the case lock
whether its source is now a part of a whole set and if so ends it stale in the same words, its attempt fenced.
Studio's drop words for .shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj/.cpg say the part is read with its other parts as one shapefile.

D1: withdrawPartReadingsTx selects the case's intake-evidence jobs on the other parts' sources with status
'queued' FOR UPDATE and ends each through endIntakeEvidenceJobTx, the evidence worker's own stop path
(metadata logical_state failed, jobs status/error/completed_at, stopIntakeEvidenceTx: coverage read 0 with
every other count unknown, candidates removed). No status added. A running job is excluded by the WHERE
after the claim's row lock, so it is left.
D2: readAsSetPart runs first inside the worker's try after the claim: case lock, setPartWordsTx(case, source),
and when words come back endIntakeEvidenceJobTx(stale, words, attempt). The case lock orders it after any
publish that formed the set in the same instant.
decisions.D3: routeWords: /\.(shp|shx|dbf|prj|cpg)$/i gives 'Shapefile part · read with its other parts as one shapefile'; a lone .dbf's server path is unchanged.
